name: kickaround
description: Several AI models discuss your question and return one verdict: the best move, why, and what's still open.

interface.longDescription:
Kickaround puts your question to several AI models at once. They answer, read each other's answers and argue it out. Then Kickaround gives you one verdict: the best move, why, and what's still open.

Use it when one answer isn't enough: a job offer, a launch date, a big purchase, a plan you want torn apart, or a claim you want checked.

Choose how they work on it:
- Opine: a view or a decision (the default)
- Critique: poke holes in a plan or draft
- Research: check facts on the web, with sources
- Brainstorm: lots of ideas
- Summarize: the short version

Say "kickaround" with your question, for example "Kickaround whether I should take the job offer." A run takes a few minutes. The verdict comes back in the chat, with a link to the whole discussion on kickaround.app, where you can ask follow-ups.

You need a Kickaround account: sign in with Google when ChatGPT asks. Kickaround sees only the questions you send it, and your threads are private to you.
capabilities: Get one verdict from several AI models
Poke holes in a plan or draft
Check facts on the web, with sources
Ask a follow-up in the same discussion
defaultPrompt: Kickaround whether I should take a job offer with a bigger salary but a longer commute
Kick this plan around and find the holes: we launch in March with no beta test
Run it by Kickaround: should I rent or buy my next home?

positive.description: Get a verdict on a decision (default mode)
positive.prompt: Kickaround whether I should take a job offer with a 20% raise but a 90-minute commute each way.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls kickaround with the question in opine mode. While the run is going (a few minutes), says so once and calls kickaround_result with the thread_id until the run is finished. Then shows Kickaround's verdict word for word, starting with "Verdict from Kickaround": the best move, why, and what's still open, followed by a link to share the verdict, a link to the full thread on kickaround.app, and a line with the run's cost and the credit left.

positive.description: Poke holes in a plan (critique mode)
positive.prompt: Kick this plan around and find the holes: we launch our app in March with no beta test and a $2,000 ad budget.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls kickaround in critique mode. Shows the verdict word for word with the thread link and cost line. The verdict names the plan's main weaknesses and the best move.

positive.description: Check facts on the web (research mode)
positive.prompt: Run it by Kickaround in research mode: do electric cars cost less to own than gas cars over five years?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls kickaround in research mode. Shows the verdict word for word with the thread link and cost line. The full thread at the link includes the web sources the models used.

positive.prompt: Kickaround some names for a neighborhood coffee shop that also sells used books.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls kickaround in brainstorm mode. Shows the verdict word for word with the thread link and cost line. The verdict picks the strongest name ideas and says why.

positive.description: Follow up in the same discussion
positive.prompt: In the same chat as the first case, once it has finished: Kick it around again: what if the commute were 45 minutes instead?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls kickaround with the same thread_id as the first case, so the models continue the same discussion. Shows the new verdict word for word, with the same thread link and the cost of this run.

negative.description: A kickaround in sport is something else: Kickaround is not used.
negative.prompt: Fancy a kickaround in the park on Saturday?

negative.description: Buying credit: the plugin sells nothing, so no tool is called. ChatGPT says credit is added on the Kickaround website.
Deleting threads: no tool deletes anything, so no tool is called. ChatGPT says threads are deleted on the Kickaround website.

review.commerce_description: Nothing is sold in ChatGPT. People buy Kickaround credit on kickaround.app, and the plugin only uses the credit already on the signed-in account. When it runs out, the plugin says so and that credit is added on the Kickaround website, with no payment link. If someone has turned on auto top-up on kickaround.app, Kickaround charges their saved card when their credit runs low, including during a run asked for in ChatGPT; the plugin never shows a payment, a payment link or a request to pay.

publication.release_notes: First release: ask Kickaround from ChatGPT and get one verdict from several AI models, with a link to the full discussion.
